notes:
✓ Cart stock ceiling: a product with 5 in stock can no longer be sold 6.
✓ All five add-to-cart paths (tile, variant picker, barcode scanner, cart + button)
   now share one ceiling; two dead functions that looked like the fix site were removed.
✓ Out-of-stock tiles are refused in code, not only by CSS pointer-events.
✓ An open drawer is restored from Supabase on boot, so clearing site data or
   reinstalling the app no longer strands a shift open in the cloud.
✓ The cart is trimmed to real stock after a cloud pull, so another till selling
   the last units cannot leave an unfulfillable total on screen.
✓ Start shift can no longer be double-tapped into two drawers.
✓ Grid scroll position is held on all five cart actions, not just the tile tap.
